process_description: CANONICAL create a new accountability plan. Returns the new plan with ID. CANONICAL view a plan from submitted state. Returns the plan details. CANONICAL export a plan as Markdown or JSON. Returns the exported content. CANONICAL add an entity (organization, person) to the plan. CANONICAL add an evidence item to the plan. CANONICAL add a next step / action item to the plan. CANONICAL mark a step as complete in the plan. CANONICAL get the default next-step templates pre-populated when creating a new plan.
